note: The fixed rules of the environment-iteration loop (LOOP.md 3). Every iteration is trained and evaluated with exactly these numbers. Do not edit between iterations; a change needs a new version and a re-evaluation of every iteration (AGENTS.md 4).

eval.state_init_random_prob_note: env.yaml sets 0.1 for training (STF noisy init); upstream also applies it in --test, so ~7% of experiments/tools/evaluate.py episodes started from a noisy, re-sampled state (e.g. reference frame 94) and could never succeed. The loop evaluates clean frame-2 starts only.
